shots.excerpt: Low tracking shot just behind the spinning blade as it skims wet asphalt. Must show: the blade centred; a little girl in a yellow raincoat blows up a pink balloon until it hides her face.
shots.voice: Shot 3. The camera rides right behind the blade, low over the wet road, straight at the pink balloon.

shots.excerpt: Interior side view inside the bus: the blade punches through the window. Must show: a radial spiderweb of cracks and flying white shards; a passenger covers her face.
shots.voice: Shot 7. We cut inside the bus. The blade punches through the glass in a perfect spiderweb of cracks.

shots.excerpt: Low frontal push-in: a figure in a red hood charges with a blazing ring of fire; the blade flies through its centre and the camera follows, flames washing the frame.
shots.voice: Shot 10. A ring of fire erupts, and the camera dives straight through it with the blade.

shots.voice: Shot 15. The second balloon pops, and the reveal: the girl was waiting at the end of the alley the whole time.

shots.excerpt: Medium frontal shot, locked-off: without looking up from her phone she raises one finger and the blade lands on her fingertip, still spinning. Must show: blade balanced flat.
shots.voice: Shot 16. A calm locked-off shot. She catches the blade on one fingertip, without even looking up from her phone.
